brief.Text: Five Memorial Caretakers keep the names. Target each of them, in the Valley and the Forest, then return. {completequest XK0S}

progress.Text: All five Memorial Caretakers must be targeted. Then I will have Volume Four.

turnin.Text: The names are marked. Take Volume Four. Shivering Pete waits in the Valley, 2320 by 1218. {completequest XK0Y}

after.Text: Shivering Pete is in the Valley, 2320 by 1218.
